title: Surreal Dream Realm
description: A surreal composite scene divided into distinct realms. The upper portion features a massive twisted tree with a glowing green spiral eye and a dark gothic castle under a starry night sky with multiple moons. The lower left shows two bloody skeletons with red drips, while the lower right depicts a large blue and red mushroom character with big white eyes standing in water next to a small yellow mushroom and a red rat with white belly looking toward it.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting split into multiple realms: top features a giant gnarled tree with a massive hypnotic green and yellow spiral eye for a canopy and a dark gothic castle silhouette against a starry purple night sky with three glowing moons. Bottom left shows two grim skeletons with blood dripping from their skulls. Bottom right shows a cute but eerie large blue mushroom character with red cap and white spots standing in reflective water next to a tiny yellow mushroom and a red rat with white chest looking at them.
